items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: met a couple of musicians, one of them was a guy I’ve known ever since, a bass player by the name of Jack Six.

ctx.x: That’s how you get into the scene?
Yeah. The first day I was there I went to Junior’s Bar. It was on 52nd Street between Broadway and Eighth Avenue. And someone told me, probably Bob Newman, as soon as © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

you get to New York go to Junior’s Bar, that’s where everybody is, and just tell them that you’re there. I did it. The first night I was there like somebody took me to a jam session. And I played, met a couple of musicians, one of them was a guy I’ve known ever since, a bass player by the name of Jack Six. And the very first night, it might have been the second night, but I was a new, just completely new to the city, that’s when I met Jack. Yeah just hanging out, getting your face in and gaining a reputation in…
